adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Steve and Natasha, still on the run together, rescue Wanda and Vision from Thanos's forces in Edinburgh, then fight side by side to defend Vision in Wakanda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Rescues Wanda and Vision with Natasha in Edinburgh.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights beside Steve in Edinburgh and Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, take them to the Compound and then Wakanda, where they lead the defense together.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Natasha, Steve and Sam bring Vision to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts them by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them, but Rhodes ends the call.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Natasha's arrest when she returns to the Avengers Compound.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fugitive Ross orders arrested at the Avengers Compound.
adds.evidence: Ross, by hologram, confronts the three wanted fugitives (Rogers, Romanoff, Wilson) who arrive at the Compound and orders Rhodes to arrest them; Rhodes cuts the connection.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When a spaceship appears over New York during a school field trip, Ned creates a distraction on the bus so Peter can slip away and suit up.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Slips off the field trip bus to suit up while Ned covers for him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Covers for Peter on the field trip bus.
adds.evidence: From the Midtown field trip bus Peter sees the Q-Ship; Ned provides a distraction while Peter leaves and dons the suit.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Okoye is in Shuri's lab as Shuri explains how she can remove the Mind Stone from Vision, until an alert warns Okoye of ships entering the atmosphere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Works to save Vision as Okoye looks on.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Stands by in Shuri's lab while she studies Vision.
adds.evidence: Okoye goes into the medical center and watches as Shuri speaks with Rogers, Romanoff, Banner and Maximoff about removing the Mind Stone; Okoye then gets the alert about an alien craft. Same scene, but no direct exchange between the two is described, hence medium.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Okoye fights at T'Challa's side in the battle for Wakanda, and when Thanos snaps his fingers T'Challa turns to dust in front of her as he reaches to help her up.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, who turns to dust beside her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights at T'Challa's side in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Both lead the Wakandan defense; after the Snap, 'Black Panther, attempting to help Okoye up, fell into ashes before her eyes.'

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Quill and Rocket help pull Thor from space, then the Guardians split up: Rocket flies off with Thor to Nidavellir while Quill leads the others to Knowhere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves with Thor for Nidavellir as the Guardians split.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the other Guardians to Knowhere as the team splits.
adds.evidence: The Guardians rescue Thor; Thor, Rocket and Groot go to Nidavellir while Quill, Gamora, Drax and Mantis go to Knowhere.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Sam flies with Steve and Natasha to rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then fights under Steve's lead to defend Vision in Wakanda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Sam in the Edinburgh rescue and the fight for Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Flies with Steve to rescue Wanda and Vision.
adds.evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision; in Wakanda Falcon warns the Avengers Vision is compromised and Captain America orders Banner and Maximoff to help.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Sam, Steve and Natasha bring Vision to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts them by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them, but Rhodes ends the call.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Sam's arrest when he returns to the Avengers Compound.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fugitive Ross orders arrested at the Avengers Compound.
adds.evidence: Ross is told Vision was rescued by three wanted criminals including Falcon, confronts them at the Compound by hologram and orders Rhodes to arrest them; Rhodes cuts the connection.
